def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = pd.Index(entity_ids)

    # --- Позиции заказов, сделанных строго до seed_time ---
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)]
    orders_sub = orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                         'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                         'order_estimated_delivery_date', 'order_status']]

    merged = items.merge(orders_sub, on='order_id', how='left')
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    base_cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'avg_freight',
        'avg_total_value', 'recency_days', 'days_since_first_sale',
        'sales_30d', 'orders_30d', 'sales_90d', 'orders_90d', 'sales_180d', 'orders_180d',
        'avg_delivery_days', 'delayed_rate', 'avg_delay_days',
        'delivered_ratio', 'cancel_ratio',
        'avg_review_score', 'count_reviews', 'neg_review_rate',
        'avg_review_recency_days',
        'avg_installments', 'credit_card_share', 'total_payments',
    ]

    if merged.empty:
        for c in base_cols:
            features[c] = 0.0
        return features.reindex(entity_ids)

    merged['total_value'] = merged['price'] + merged['freight_value']
    merged['time_since_sale_days'] = (seed_time - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    # --- Базовые агрегации по всем продажам до seed_time ---
    agg = merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        avg_total_value=('total_value', 'mean'),
        recency_days=('time_since_sale_days', 'min'),
        days_since_first_sale=('time_since_sale_days', 'max'),
    )

    # --- Скользящие окна продаж ---
    for w, name in [(30, '30d'), (90, '90d'), (180, '180d')]:
        win = merged[merged['time_since_sale_days'] <= w]
        w_agg = win.groupby('product_id').agg(**{
            f'sales_{name}': ('price', 'sum'),
            f'orders_{name}': ('order_id', 'nunique'),
        })
        agg = agg.join(w_agg, how='left')

    # --- Признаки доставки: только по заказам, доставка которых уже известна (< seed_time) ---
    deliv = merged[merged['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() &
                   (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)].copy()
    if not deliv.empty:
        deliv['delivery_days'] = (
            deliv['order_delivered_customer_date'] - deliv['order_purchase_timestamp']
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        deliv['delay_days'] = (
            deliv['order_delivered_customer_date'] - deliv['order_estimated_delivery_date']
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        deliv['is_delayed'] = (deliv['delay_days'] > 0).astype(float)
        d_agg = deliv.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
            avg_delay_days=('delay_days', 'mean'),
            delayed_rate=('is_delayed', 'mean'),
        )
        agg = agg.join(d_agg, how='left')

    # --- Доля доставленных / отменённых заказов (статус известен на seed_time) ---
    st = merged.dropna(subset=['order_purchase_timestamp']).copy()
    order_status = st.drop_duplicates('order_id')[['order_id', 'order_status', 'product_id']]
    order_status['is_delivered'] = (order_status['order_status'] == 'delivered').astype(float)
    order_status['is_canceled'] = (order_status['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])).astype(float)
    st_agg = order_status.groupby('product_id').agg(
        delivered_ratio=('is_delivered', 'mean'),
        cancel_ratio=('is_canceled', 'mean'),
    )
    agg = agg.join(st_agg, how='left')

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже опубликованы (review_creation_date < seed_time) ---
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    rev_merge = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates('order_id').merge(
        rev, on='order_id', how='inner')
    if not rev_merge.empty:
        rev_merge['is_neg'] = (rev_merge['review_score'] <= 2).astype(float)
        rev_merge['review_age_days'] = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp(seed_time)).dt.days  # placeholder
        rev_creation = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_creation_date']]
        rev_merge = rev_merge.merge(rev_creation, on='order_id', how='left')
        rev_merge['review_age_days'] = (
            (seed_time - rev_merge['review_creation_date']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        )
        r_agg = rev_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            count_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
            neg_review_rate=('is_neg', 'mean'),
            avg_review_recency_days=('review_age_days', 'min'),
        )
        agg = agg.join(r_agg, how='left')

    # --- Платежи: только по заказам, существующим до seed_time ---
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'payment_installments',
                                                'payment_type', 'payment_value']]
    pay_merge = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates('order_id').merge(
        pay, on='order_id', how='inner')
    if not pay_merge.empty:
        pay_merge['is_cc'] = (pay_merge['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(float)
        p_agg = pay_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            credit_card_share=('is_cc', 'mean'),
            total_payments=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        )
        agg = agg.join(p_agg, how='left')

    features = features.join(agg, how='left')
    features = features.fillna(0.0).astype(float)

    return features.reindex(entity_ids)
